entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah... I hope you can help. I bought some cycling shoes a few weeks ago, and I need to return them. I'm just so disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear you're disappointed with your purchase. I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I please have your order number?
Yes, it's VF886-0921. I've been a loyal customer for years, I just... I really thought these would be the ones.

Thank you, I have your order pulled up. I see the VeloPro cycling shoes, delivered about 30 days ago. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference or fit issue?
It's the fit. I spent an hour setting up the cleats perfectly, but after just one ride, I got the most painful blisters on my heels. I just can't wear them again.

Oh no, getting blisters is a terrible experience, and definitely not what we want for our customers. I completely understand why you'd want to return them. Let me just confirm the return policy for you.
I really hope you can. I saved up for these and I really needed this money back for some other things.

Of course. Okay, I've checked our policy here, and standard items like these shoes have a 90-day return window. Since you're only at 30 days, you are well within that timeframe. I can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Oh, really? That's... that's a huge relief. Thank you so much, Sarah. I was so worried.

You are very welcome. I'm happy I could get this sorted out for you. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email address on file right now. Just pack the shoes in the original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Your refund will be processed once we receive it.
That's perfect. Thank you again for your help.
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. You've been great.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
